# vue-onlyoffice-local

> A Vue 3 plugin for purely local OnlyOffice document editing. It opens and edits
> DOCX, XLSX and PPTX entirely in the browser: no document server, no uploads, no
> X2T conversion service. Documents are passed to the editor as Blob URLs and the
> edited bytes are returned to the host component.

Live demo: https://onlyoffice.zkhi.top
Source: https://github.com/zuoanCo/vue-onlyoffice-local
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zzk-1015/vue-onlyoffice-local
License: MIT

## Install

```
npm install @zzk-1015/vue-onlyoffice-local
```

## What it does

- Renders a full OnlyOffice editor inside a Vue 3 app with one component.
- Supports DOCX, XLSX and PPTX editing, plus PDF export.
- Keeps the document in the browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
- Returns the edited bytes to the host page through a postMessage file-stream
  hook, exposed as an imperative `save(format?)` on the component's template ref.
- Offers three entry points: the `<VueOnlyOfficeLocal>` component, the
  `useOnlyOffice()` composable, and the headless `createEditor()` SDK.

## Register the plugin

```ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import VueOnlyOfficeLocal from '@zzk-1015/vue-onlyoffice-local';
import '@zzk-1015/vue-onlyoffice-local/style.css';

const app = createApp(App);
app.use(VueOnlyOfficeLocal, {
  defaultBaseUrl: '/',
  globalConfig: { editorConfig: { lang: 'en' } },
});
app.mount('#app');
```

## Use the component

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { VueOnlyOfficeLocal } from '@zzk-1015/vue-onlyoffice-local';

const editor = ref<InstanceType<typeof VueOnlyOfficeLocal> | null>(null);
const file = ref<File | null>(null);

async function download() {
  const result = await editor.value?.save();
  if (result) {
    // result.buffer is an ArrayBuffer, result.fileName / result.fileType are set
    triggerBrowserDownload(result.buffer, result.fileName, result.fileType);
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <VueOnlyOfficeLocal
    v-if="file"
    ref="editor"
    :file="file"
    file-name="report.docx"
    base-url="/"
    @error="onError"
  />
</template>
```

## Events

`ready`, `document-ready`, `state-change`, `request-close`, `meta-change`,
`save`, `error`.

## Deployment requirement

The plugin needs a self-hosted copy of the OnlyOffice 9.x offline vendor build
(about 700 MB), served from your own origin. DocsAPI is loaded from
`<baseUrl>/vendor/web-apps/apps/api/documents/api.js`; the SDK is served from
`<baseUrl>/vendor/sdkjs/`.

Serve that tree gzip-encoded. `x2t.wasm` alone is roughly 62 MB uncompressed and
`X2TConverter` gives up after 60 seconds, so pre-build `.gz` sidecars and enable
`gzip_static on;` rather than compressing the file on every request.

## Architecture note

This follows the `onlyoffice-web-local` v2.0.0 oo-offline architecture. The v1
`defaultSdkUrl` and `defaultX2tUrl` options are deprecated and ignored since
v2.0.0; conversion happens inside the offline editor build.
